title: GSI Outdoors Names Karl Fritzsche Senior Product Manager
summary: GSI Outdoors Names Karl Fritzsche Senior Product Manager

sentences: GSI Outdoors has appointed Karl Fritzsche senior product manager on the company’s product development team.
Fritzsche will help lead consumer product strategy at GSI Outdoors, including design, development, and global sourcing.
Fritzsche’s appointment is the latest in a series of momentum-building strategic hires for GSI Outdoors since the original founding family bought the company back this year.
His arrival closely follows the additions of outdoor industry veteran Shawn Hostetter as CEO and digital commerce leader Maddy Scott as head of marketing.
“Karl’s experience perfectly aligns with our new GSI Outdoors business strategy,” said CEO Shawn Hostetter.
“Developing high-performing, long-lasting, and thoughtfully designed gear is at the center of all we do.

We are excited to have Karl join our incredibly talented team.”
“I’m excited to join GSI Outdoors and be part of a company with such a strong legacy in the outdoor industry,” said Fritzsche.

“Throughout my career, I’ve had the opportunity to work with many great brands, and I’ve always been passionate about developing purposeful products that help people get outside and make the most of their time outdoors.
I look forward to bringing that experience to GSI, working with the team to build on the company’s heritage, bring new ideas to life, and continue delivering products that outdoor enthusiasts love.”
